prompt: How fast do we actually have to patch things for Cyber Essentials, and what about our old Windows Server 2012 box?
assertions: States the 14-day rule with its criteria: apply updates within 14 days when vendor-rated critical or high risk, OR CVSS v3 base score 7.0+, OR no vendor severity detail provided
Covers automatic updates: enable them wherever possible

Handles unsupported software correctly: Windows Server 2012 (out of support) must be REMOVED, or moved out of scope into a defined sub-set that blocks ALL internet traffic both directions — keeping it in scope is a certification failure
Notes the 14-day update questions are automatic-fail questions under the current (Danzell) marking
Mentions firmware counts as software (with firewall/router firmware needing make/model listing)
